verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents trace sampling controls, log sampling, or retention tiers such as ILM or hot/warm/cold storage. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: predictable storage costs via time series data streams applies to metrics, and the logs@custom component template is a general template configuration point, not a documented sampling or retention-tier control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
